profile.headline: Software Engineer | Tech | .Net, C#, Python, AI, Angular, React, Azure | Challenges are Opportunities for Growth
profile.summary:
Why I'm Passionate about Software Development:

I find great fulfillment in the world of software development due to my love for puzzles and the excitement that comes with exploring new technologies. Throughout my journey, I have actively pursued learning opportunities, building small applications to apply my newfound knowledge. This iterative process has allowed me to continuously refine my skills and grow as a developer.

What Sets Me Apart:

My experience as a collegiate football player and track athlete has instilled in me a deep appreciation for teamwork and collaborative environments. I thrive when working alongside others, valuing the power of strong teamwork in achieving success. As a teammate, I take pride in supporting and uplifting those around me, believing that collective achievement leads to individual and organizational success. My most significant personal growth has come from facing adversity head-on, reinforcing my commitment to hard work and the mantra of "work for work."

Diverse Industry Background:

Having worked in the automotive, insurance, finance, and pharmaceutical sectors, I bring a valuable breadth of experience to my software development career. This exposure to various industries has taught me the importance of understanding the end-users' needs and expectations. By integrating these insights, I aim to create applications that provide exceptional user experiences, both in professional settings and personal projects.

By sharing my passion for puzzles, dedication to teamwork, and diverse industry background, I look forward to contributing to the continued growth and success of the software development field.
